note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 1D零Dirichlet Bratuの31内点と5観測を用いる2係数逆問題。既存合成観測を再利用し、物理boxはa∈[1,2.8],b∈[-.5,.5]。目的正則化γ、LM減衰μ、変数尺度は別です。 小さい滑らかな分枝の局所比較。SciPy最適化ライブラリは参照側でも共有し、大域最小・一意性を証明しません。LMに箱制約があるとは説明しません。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference A two-coefficient inverse problem uses 31 interior nodes and five observations of the one-dimensional zero-Dirichlet Bratu model. Reuse existing synthetic data; the physical box is a in[1,2.8],b in[-.5,.5]. Objective regularization gamma, LM damping mu and variable scaling are distinct. A local comparison on a small smooth branch. The optimizer library is shared by the reference and a companion; no global minimum or uniqueness proof is claimed. LM is not presented as a box-constrained method.
